tariff.note: P2.2: the US state tariffs the engine ships are grade-B leads from EIA, not values re-verified at the primary source. R-DATA-08 makes re-verification the condition of embedding, so this stays unknown until that pass happens rather than being carried across as if it had been checked.

fixed_charge.note: P2.3: not yet populated. Unknown is a permitted value and triggers the check-your-bill prompt instead of a guess.

export_regime.note: P2.4: export rules are policy and carry a 6-month review window. Net metering, net billing and buy-all-sell-all differ by state, and this file is national scope, so the honest national answer is unknown until P2.4 lands the sub-national rows.

legality_gridtie.note: P2.4: grid-tie legality is a policy field with a 6-month window and varies by state and utility.

legality_offgrid.note: P2.4: off-grid legality hinges on local code and permit rules that a national row cannot honestly summarise.

legality_battery_only.note: P2.4: battery-only legality is a policy field with a 6-month window.

legality_portable.note: P2.4: portable-system rules are a policy field with a 6-month window.

turnkey_benchmark.note: P2.2: the shipped turnkey figure is the site's own hardware estimate times a multiplier (F-01), which is a derivation and not a market benchmark. It cannot be graded until a published benchmark is cited, so it is unknown here.

hardware_landed_factor.note: P2.3: not yet populated from a citable landed-cost source.

electrician_rate.note: P2.3: the shipped labour model is our own regional estimate (grade D territory); P2.3 either cites a rate survey or records it as a derivation with its formula.

permit_fees.note: P2.4: permit fees are jurisdictional and belong with the policy pass.

lease_available.note: P2.3: lease and PPA availability are not populated yet.

lease_term_years.note: P2.3: no citable term data yet.

lease_buyout_pct.note: P2.3: no citable buyout data yet.

inflation_rate.note: P2.3: the engine assumes flat prices; the registry row for the assumption itself is what P2.3 fills.

pv_degradation_d1.note: The engine ships 0.02 (paths.js DEGRADATION.firstYear); the band is the range NREL reports for current modules.
